propositions: The review bot fetches a tree using patchSet.ref but casts its vote against patchSet.revision, which are independently-supplied fields that may not correspond to the same commit
A stale or reused clone directory, partial fetch, or future refactor of checkout logic could result in a tree that does not match the voted revision without any detection signal
The review bot must assert that the resolved FETCH_HEAD equals patchSet.revision after fetch and checkout, and refuse to vote with a fail-closed error if they mismatch
The adapter.py ref parameter should perform the FETCH_HEAD-to-revision assertion instead of remaining unread, preserving the interface contract described in ADR 0009 and ADR 0015
A test must verify that a FETCH_HEAD-to-revision mismatch correctly blocks voting to prevent false positives from breaking all reviews
